description: This file defines an API client using axios for making HTTP requests. It includes functions for deriving the base URL based on environment variables or current window location, sets up an axios instance with interceptors for error normalization, and provides functions for performing health checks and retrieving the API base URL.

methods.name: deriveBaseUrl()
methods.description: Derives the API base URL from environment variables or current window location, defaulting to 'http://localhost:3001' if needed.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl()
methods.description: Returns the resolved API base URL used by the axios client.

methods.name: healthCheck()
methods.description: Performs a health check by sending a GET request to the health path and returns the status and data.
